steps: Click the 'Compete!' button on the competition page to enroll in the GEMS Prize Challenge.
Read the overview and problem description to understand the fault-prediction task.
Download the data from the Data tab.
Create and train your own model (a reference solution is linked on the page).
Generate predictions matching the submission format.
Click 'Submit' in the sidebar, then 'Make new submission'. The same submission is scored in both the Initial and Final prize rounds.
timing: Competition End Date: Dec. 3, 2026, 11:59 p.m. UTC. The same submission is scored twice — once against a private expert-labeled test set (Initial round), and again against an expanded label set for the Final round.
